name: AI Content Advisor
description: Analyze your content and receive AI-powered recommendations on how to improve it.
project_description:
AI Content Advisor renders a node's HTML, sends it to a configured drupal/ai chat model with an analysis prompt, and stores an AI-generated report of improvement recommendations. It grew out of the AI SEO Analyzer project and ships several SEO-oriented report templates, but its report types are configurable so it can drive any kind of content analysis (readability, editorial review, accessibility, brand compliance).

Reports are reached from a per-node "Analyze Content with AI" tab (route entity.node.content_analyzer, /node/{node}/content-advisor), from entity operations/contextual links, or from a provided block. The AnalyzeNodeForm shows previous reports and a form to generate a new one for the current (or a chosen moderated) revision. Reports are stored in the module's own ai_content_advisor database table and can be regenerated and compared over time.

Report prompts are managed as AiContentAdvisorReportType config entities (config-installed defaults: full, topic_authority, natural_language, link_analysis, headings_and_structure) at /admin/config/ai-content-advisor/report-types. The provider/model and an optional custom system prompt are set at /admin/config/ai/content-advisor.

Key features:
- Per-node AI content analysis with stored, comparable reports.
- Configurable report types (prompts) as config entities, with SEO defaults.
- Analyze the published node or a specific moderated revision.
- Optional 'analyze as an anonymous visitor' rendering to respect access restrictions.
- Granular permissions for viewing, creating, and administering.
- A context-aware block for embedding the latest report on a node.

Requirements: the AI module (ai) with a configured chat provider, and the league/commonmark library (pulled via Composer). Generating reports calls the AI provider and incurs usage cost.
